name: Market Europa Café

intro: Breakfast, panini, handmade gnocchi from Antonio's fresh gnocchi bar, and proper coffee. Order and pay at the front counter; no bookings needed.

allergenNote: Ask our team about allergens. Dishes may contain or come into contact with gluten, dairy, egg, nuts, sesame and fish.
